# P40.1A — Boundary Migration Inventory (Updated)

**Date:** 2026-05-30
**Updated:** 2026-05-30 (P40.1 — physical package extraction correction)
**Generated by:** manual grep

## Corrected Direction

The P40.0 scaffold placed boundary modules *inside* `packages/coding-agent/src/`. For P40.1, these must be **physically extracted** to separate workspace packages:

- `packages/coding-agent/src/execution-core/` → `packages/execution-core/` (canonical contracts)
- `packages/coding-agent/src/execution-service/` → `packages/execution-service/` (command/query facades)
- `packages/coding-agent/src/worker-adapter/` → `packages/worker-adapters/` (worker adapter implementations)

After extraction, old paths become **compatibility shims** re-exporting from new packages.

## Migration Plan (P40.1)

### A. Files copied into execution-core

1. `types.ts` → split into `types.ts`, `commands.ts`, `read-model.ts`, `events.ts`
2. `worker-adapter/types.ts` → `worker-adapter.ts` (WorkerAdapter interface stays in execution-core)

### B. Files copied into execution-service

1. `command-handler.ts` — copies as-is, updates imports to @earendil-works/pi-execution-core
2. `query-handler.ts` — copies as-is, updates imports to @earendil-works/pi-execution-core
3. New `execution-service.ts` — higher-level facade

### C. Files copied into worker-adapters

1. `local-pi-worker-adapter.ts` — imports WorkerAdapter from @earendil-works/pi-execution-core, WorkspaceAgentExecutor from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent

### D. Old paths become compatibility shims

1. `packages/coding-agent/src/execution-core/index.ts` → re-exports from @earendil-works/pi-execution-core
2. `packages/coding-agent/src/execution-service/index.ts` → re-exports from @earendil-works/pi-execution-service
3. `packages/coding-agent/src/worker-adapter/index.ts` → re-exports from @earendil-works/pi-worker-adapters
4. `packages/coding-agent/src/worker-adapter/types.ts` → re-exports from @earendil-works/pi-execution-core (WorkerAdapter)

### E. Files to keep as legacy compatibility shims

1. `core/autonomous-executor.ts` — keep backward-compat WorkspaceAgentExecutor path, but WorkerAdapter imports come from new package
2. `execution-kernel/` — keep as-is during transition
3. `index.ts` — keep re-exports for backward compat (some may re-export from new packages)

### F. Files explicitly not safe to move in P40.1

1. `execution-kernel/transition-router.ts` — deeply coupled to DB/Postgres
2. `execution-kernel/state-writer.ts` — deeply coupled to state store
3. `execution-kernel/attempt-fsm.ts` — deeply coupled to FSM transitions
4. `core/state-store.ts` — IStateStore interface, would break imports everywhere
5. `core/completion-gate.ts` — P37-stabilized, not safe to touch
6. `core/execution-gauntlet/**` — test infrastructure, keep as-is
7. `packages/db/**` — separate package
8. `packages/ai/**` — separate package
9. `packages/web-ui/dashboard/**` — separate app
